# Banner Connect Help Center

> Official how-to help for Banner Connect, the enrollment CRM Banner 61 sets up for K-12 Christian schools.

Index with what each article covers: https://demo.banner61.com/help/index.txt
Everything in one file: https://demo.banner61.com/help/banner-connect-help.txt

## Articles

- [About Banner Connect](https://demo.banner61.com/help/articles/about-banner-connect.md): What Banner Connect is, where to sign in, the full menu and what each tab holds, what the words mean (contact, opportunity, pipeline, stage, tag, smart list, workflow), and what Banner 61 handles versus the school.
- [Getting started](https://demo.banner61.com/help/articles/getting-started.md): First login, password, the first four setup steps, connecting a staff member's email (two-way sync), reviewing forms and emails before they go live, sharing website domain access with Banner 61.
- [Contacts](https://demo.banner61.com/help/articles/contacts.md): Finding, adding, importing, exporting or merging families; what's on a family's record; tags; filtering the contact list. Saved lists such as Stalled Leads are in Smart Lists.
- [The enrollment pipeline (Opportunities)](https://demo.banner61.com/help/articles/pipeline.md): The enrollment pipeline: where every family sits, moving a family to a stage (Visit Scheduled, Accepted, Enrolled), status (Won, Lost), stalled families, bulk updates, deleting and restoring a family, why stages shouldn't be renamed.
- [Conversations, snippets and texting](https://demo.banner61.com/help/articles/conversations.md): Replying to families by email, text or social; connecting Facebook, Instagram and Google Business Profile; snippets (saved replies); texting and its phone number and registration; trigger links.
- [Tasks and notifications](https://demo.banner61.com/help/articles/tasks.md): Creating and assigning follow-up tasks, due dates, getting notified when a task is assigned, and reading the Dashboard.
- [Calendars](https://demo.banner61.com/help/articles/calendars.md): The prebuilt calendars (Schedule a Visit, Event Registration), connecting a staff calendar, booking a visit for a family who called or walked in, changing available times, open houses and events, embedding or sharing a calendar on the school website.
- [Forms, surveys and documents](https://demo.banner61.com/help/articles/forms-and-docs.md): The prebuilt forms (Request Info Packet, General Inquiry, tuition and financial aid), putting the inquiry form on the school website, editing a form and its fields, surveys, and documents and contracts families sign (enrollment agreements).
- [Marketing](https://demo.banner61.com/help/articles/marketing.md): Email templates and their wording, one-time email campaigns to a group (newsletter, current families), trigger links, funnels (landing pages), QR codes, the Social Planner and video testimonials.
- [Automations (workflows)](https://demo.banner61.com/help/articles/automations.md): What the prebuilt workflows do (after an inquiry, after a visit, open house follow-up, cold inquiry revival, stalled families), the staff follow-up email after a visit, what's safe to change, and why an email didn't send.
- [Dashboard, reporting and payments](https://demo.banner61.com/help/articles/reporting-and-payments.md): The Dashboard, lead source and other reports (where inquiries come from), email results, and taking payments: connecting Stripe or PayPal, application fees, enrollment deposits, payment links and invoices.
- [Advanced and settings](https://demo.banner61.com/help/articles/advanced-and-settings.md): Custom values (school name, address, phone used in every email), custom fields (grade of interest and other details), merge fields for personalizing messages, Business Profile, Users and access for staff, Integrations and Audit Logs.
- [Smart Lists](https://demo.banner61.com/help/articles/smart-lists.md): What a smart list is; the lists in your account (Current Families, Stalled Leads); finding families in one grade without saving a list; making a list of families by stage or activity; families who haven't heard from us; why a family is on Stalled Leads; emailing or tagging everyone on a list.
- [Bulk actions (do one thing to many families)](https://demo.banner61.com/help/articles/bulk-actions.md): Doing one thing to a whole group of families at once: tagging or untagging a list, moving a group to a new pipeline stage, starting an automation for a list, a quick email to a list, naming a bulk job and checking whether it finished.
- [Engagement score](https://demo.banner61.com/help/articles/engagement-score.md): What a family's engagement score means, how points are added and taken away (forms, visits, applications, replies, email clicks), which families to call first, why a score is low or went down, and where the scoring rules live.
- [Your enrollment board, stage by stage](https://demo.banner61.com/help/articles/enrollment-stages.md): What each stage of the Inquiry to Enrollment pipeline means (New Inquiry, Visit Scheduled, Visit Attended, Application Sent, Application Submitted, Accepted, Enrolled), when to move a family to the next stage, which moves happen on their own, and what to do when a family decides not to enroll.
- [How many families will enroll this fall?](https://demo.banner61.com/help/articles/enrollment-forecast.md): How many new families and students are likely to enroll for next school year, how much tuition that means, which month families are likely to decide, where the odds come from, why the forecast says expected revenue (it means expected tuition), and how to replace the starting odds with your school's own history.
- [One inbox for every parent message](https://demo.banner61.com/help/articles/parent-inbox.md): Where parent emails, texts, Facebook and Instagram messages and website chats show up; how to see what's new; how to hand a family to a colleague; what the family details beside each message mean; how to leave a note for staff without the family seeing it.
- [Open houses, Vision Nights and Promoter Receptions](https://demo.banner61.com/help/articles/events.md): Setting up an event page families can RSVP to, such as an open house, a Vision Night or a Promoter Reception; adding a cover image, FAQs and RSVP questions; publishing the page and sharing the link; seeing who RSVPed and checking families in; closing RSVPs; when to use Events instead of the Event Registration calendar.
- [Let families book a campus visit](https://demo.banner61.com/help/articles/campus-visits.md): Setting up campus visits so families can book them online: visit hours, who gives the visit, where the booking link goes on your website and in emails, and what happens automatically after a family books and after the visit.
- [Run an open house with sign-ups and reminders](https://demo.banner61.com/help/articles/open-houses.md): Running an open house, preview night or information night: adding the date and time, letting families sign up online, inviting families by email, the confirmation and reminder emails, and following up after the event.
